input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

This isn't actually in the CSV writer — the merging happens earlier, during ingest. `dedupeKey` in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` builds its key from `date`, `amount`, and `description` only, so two transactions that differ solely by `currency` (e.g. one EUR, one USD) hash to the same key and the second one is dropped as a duplicate. This went unnoticed before 3.2.0 because transactions didn't carry a currency yet, so there was no way for two otherwise-identical rows to legitimately differ. The fix is to include `t.currency` in the key built by `dedupeKey`.

input.title: Include currency in dedupe key to avoid merging distinct transactions
input.body: File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts. The dedupeKey function builds its key from date, amount and description only, so two transactions that differ solely by currency (e.g. one EUR, one USD) hash to the same key and the second is dropped as a duplicate. Update dedupeKey to also include t.currency in the joined key so transactions with different currencies are no longer incorrectly merged.
